results.title: J. Larry Jameson - Wikipedia
results.snippet: James Larry Jameson III is the 10th president of the University of Pennsylvania, appointed in March 13, 2025, with a term extending through June 2027. He initially assumed the role of Interim President in December 2023. Jameson also holds the title of Trustees University Professor at Penn.
